completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Lift Upgrading Works) (No. 3) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 9 June 2023.

heading.en: Declaration of precincts for lift upgrading works

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be precincts for the purpose of carrying out lift upgrading works.

THE SCHEDULE
1. All that part of the housing estate of the Board —
(a)bounded by Bishan Street 11 and Bishan Street 12, comprised in Lot number 06253N in Mukim 17 and on which Apartment Block 119 is erected, and which is more particularly delineated in Plan 1A; and
Plan 1A
bishan STREET 12
(b)at Bishan Street 12 comprised in Lot number 06253N in Mukim 17 and on which Apartment Block 134 is erected, and which is more particularly delineated in Plan 1B.
